title: Study card
description: A living card for one study session the user asked for: test them, find their weak spots, teach the gap, re-test, plan their reviews. The quiz runs in the card: the user answers every question there, then one click sends values {quiz, answers: {question id: option id}, score, total}. Show it once, then update it after each step.

subtitle.description: One line of context: the subject, the exam, the deadline.

status.description: running: you are working (writing questions, grading, scheduling). quiz: the user is answering the quiz in the card. waiting: you need the user's decision (offer it in actions). done / failed: finished.

status_text.description: One short line shown with a spinner or icon.

steps.description: The session plan, in order, e.g. diagnostic, weak spots, lesson, re-test, reviews.

detail.description: Result in a few words: "3/5", "2 weak spots".

quiz.description: The round the user answers now. A new id starts a new round; remove the quiz (null) once its answers are in.

topic.description: The topic id this question tests.

answer.description: The id of the right option.

explain.description: One sentence shown once the user answered.

topics.description: Where the user stands, from their answers: one row per topic.

lesson.description: A short lesson on the weak spots: a few key ideas and flashcards the user flips in the card.

schedule.description: Planned reviews. planned: proposed; set: the reminder exists (from the tool result); done: reviewed.

explanation.description: Why the agent needs a decision, in one or two sentences.

actions.description: Decisions offered to the user. While a quiz is on, the card shows them once every question is answered; the click sends the answers with it. Offer none and a finished quiz shows its own "Send my answers" (action_id submit_quiz).
